obernants.operator: Exclude rel endpoints in O/L/R/E/P/B/F/K, snapshot-form IDs, exact duplicate key spellings, unmatched quotes, misplaced anchors and multiple event placements. obernants.operator: For observation (Cmd,anchors), reconstruct every line whose trim/token/Args/dispatch relation yields that pair. Whitespace between tokens, allowed key-order permutations and accepted quote variants form nonunique fibers; Args attrs preserve their source order, so not all key permutations are equivalent. The 784-string relation domain is completely enumerated with independent expected fibers; general UTF-8 reconstruction remains relational.

obernants.operator: Role Agent permits C; Patient C/O/L; To C/L; At L; Instr O. Relation a and b are C-only; event/causal/time IDs are E where requested. Identity parsing accepts uppercase registry prefix and one to six decimal digits without leading zero; snapshot @ forms are excluded by types::Id. Native 45-cell role matrix and complete endpoint fibers check correspondence.

obernants.operator: tokens groups characters between literal double quotes and splits Unicode whitespace outside; there is no escape syntax. Args requires lowercase ASCII key names, splits the first '=', rejects repeated spellings and positions after any key, and validates complete outer quote pairs. text trims value edges; quote flags are enforced by ID/word consumers but intentionally ignored by some numeric/tag/text consumers.

obernants.operator: parse_line returns None only on trimmed empty input. It scans trailing ^s tokens right-to-left before validating remaining anchors, Args, command, unused arguments and finally required anchor. Cursor sent supplies a default only without explicit anchors. Error stores untrimmed raw and supplied number, success stores trimmed raw.

obernants.operator: Closed tags and Act use exact catalog membership; word grammar and field domains come from types. Text has at most 25 whitespace-separated words. Tag sets reject duplicate tags then normalize with V::tags. num accepts zero or one-to-six ASCII digits with no leading zero, or NUM_WORD tags, so 999999 is accepted; the narrower comment is not an enforced bound.

obernants.operator: ev2 consumes before/after/during/same and rejects more than one. Ev2::placement on manually constructed state prioritizes before, after, during, same; parser-created Ev2 never needs that conflict resolution. reveal has its own placement parser; time requires exactly one relation or absolute at text.

obernants.operator: Args rejects duplicate textual keys, but attrs maps aliases at/to/in to the same Field::At without enforcing semantic uniqueness. Thus set C1 at=L1 to=L2 is admitted with two ordered Field::At entries; downstream policy is not modeled. This is not advertised as duplicate-field rejection.

obernants.operator: parse_all enumerates physical text.lines positions from one, independently parses every line and appends success/error to separate order-preserving vectors. Blank lines disappear but numbering remains physical; no rollback, execution or stop-on-first-error behavior is introduced.
